raw_answer: Tailscale Serve lets you securely expose local services (like a web server) to other devices on your Tailscale network using a unique URL like `https://<device-name>.<tailnet>.ts.net`, without opening ports or exposing the service to the public internet. It automatically handles HTTPS encryption and access control based on your tailnet’s policies, making it easy to share internal tools and apps privately.

message.content: Tailscale Serve lets you securely expose local services (like a web server) to other devices on your Tailscale network using a unique URL like `https://<device-name>.<tailnet>.ts.net`, without opening ports or exposing the service to the public internet. It automatically handles HTTPS encryption and access control based on your tailnet’s policies, making it easy to share internal tools and apps privately.
